title: bench tolerance spread file
description: Project data for ./tools/safety bench tolerance (tools/bench_tolerance.py): per tolerance field (the dotted path of a number in the project protocol `tolerances`), the oracle error bound and, per variant, the largest absolute spread against the reference and its sample count. A project check writes it; the framework names no field and no variant. The tool repeats every rule in check_spread.

source.description: Optional provenance (for example the run id of the check that wrote the file).
